#### Synthesis & Commentary
The consolidated quantitative profile matches the **Mature Capital-Intensive Omni-Channel Retailer** archetype:
1. **Capital-Intensive Floor Footprint:** Physical floor space and logistics infrastructure (Net PPE of $4,743.00M and Operating Lease ROU Assets of $2,127.00M) total $6,870.00M, representing **42.31%** of Total Assets ($16,238.00M).
2. **Seasonal Working Capital Dominance:** Merchandise Inventory stands at $4,412.00M, absorbing **66.12%** of Current Assets ($6,673.00M), indicating high vulnerability to retail inventory stocking cycles and clearance markdowns.
3. **Protracted Secular Contraction:** Consolidated revenue declined from $24,460.00M in FY2022 to $21,764.00M in FY2026, an aggregate contraction of **-11.02%**.
